claims.text: Dexamethasone 8-10 mg IV TID or methylprednisolone 2-3 mg/kg IV: ↓pain, shorter recovery vs placebo
claims.quote: Corticosteroids: Corticosteroids such as dexamethasone (8-10 mg IV three times daily) or methylprednisolone (2-3 mg/kg IV) reduce pain and shorten recovery time compared with placebo.
